cands.title: File:Nike of Paionios statue from the Archaeological Museum of Olympia in Western Peloponnese, Greece.jpg
cands.desc: This statue depicts the Greek goddess of victory Nike. The work is by Paionios (hence the name). Height of 2,11 metres; the face is missing, so is most of both arms from the elbow down. Remains of right hand have survived. Date: 421 BC. Found in the site of Ancient Olympia.
